Hanno Entrepreneurship School 2026

A 6-week course covering the fundamentals of starting a business.

【Date and Time】
Every Friday from September 4 to October 9, 2026 (Reiwa 8). Six sessions total. Each session runs 7:00 PM–9:00 PM (Reception from 6:30 PM).

【Venue】
Sessions 1–4: Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry (1-7 Honcho, Hanno)
Sessions 5–6: Hanno Credit Union Hanno Central Branch (1-3 Yawatacho, Hanno)
All sessions held in person.

【Capacity】
30 people

【Fee】
5,000 yen (tax included)

【Instructors】
Small Business Management Consultant Kenta Kitada and others

【Who Can Apply】
People considering starting a business or planning to launch a business soon

【How to Apply】
Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry Small Business Consultation Office (via email form)

For full details, visit the dedicated page on the Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2756/
